verses.original: חֲז֖וֹן עֹֽבַדְיָ֑ה כֹּֽה־ אֲדֹנָ֨י יְהוִ֜ה אָמַר֩ לֶאֱד֗וֹם שָׁמַ֜עְנוּ מֵאֵ֤ת שְׁמוּעָ֨ה יְהוָה֙ וְצִיר֙ שֻׁלָּ֔ח בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם ק֛וּמוּ וְנָק֥וּמָה לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃ עָלֶיהָ
verses.transliteration: ḥă·zō·wn ‘ō·ḇaḏ·yāh kōh- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar le·’ĕ·ḏō·wm šā·ma‘·nū mê·’êṯ šə·mū·‘āh Yah·weh wə·ṣîr šul·lāḥ bag·gō·w·yim qū·mū wə·nā·qū·māh lam·mil·ḥā·māh ʿå̄·lɛ·hå̄
verses.literal: [This is] the vision of Obadiah This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom We have heard . . . a message from the LORD an envoy has been sent among the nations [to say,] “Rise up and let us go to battle against her

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה נְתַתִּ֖יךָ קָטֹ֛ן בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם אַתָּ֖ה מְאֹֽד׃ בָּז֥וּי
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā qā·ṭōn bag·gō·w·yim ’at·tāh mə·’ōḏ bā·zui
verses.literal: Behold I will make you small among the nations you will be deeply despised

verses.original: זְד֤וֹן לִבְּךָ֙ הִשִּׁיאֶ֔ךָ שֹׁכְנִ֥י בְחַגְוֵי־ סֶּ֖לַע שִׁבְתּ֑וֹ מְר֣וֹם אֹמֵ֣ר בְּלִבּ֔וֹ מִ֥י יוֹרִדֵ֖נִי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḏō·wn lib·bə·ḵā hiš·šî·’e·ḵā šō·ḵə·nî ḇə·ḥaḡ·wê- se·la‘ šiḇ·tōw mə·rō·wm ’ō·mêr bə·lib·bōw mî yō·w·ri·ḏê·nî ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The pride of your heart has deceived you O dwellers in the clefts of the rocks whose habitation is the heights who say in your heart Who can bring me down to the ground

verses.original: אִם־ תַּגְבִּ֣יהַּ כַּנֶּ֔שֶׁר וְאִם־ שִׂ֣ים קִנֶּ֑ךָ בֵּ֥ין כּֽוֹכָבִ֖ים מִשָּׁ֥ם אוֹרִֽידְךָ֖ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- taḡ·bî·ah kan·ne·šer wə·’im- śîm qin·ne·ḵā bên kō·w·ḵā·ḇîm miš·šām ’ō·w·rî·ḏə·ḵā nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Though you soar like the eagle . . . and make your nest among the stars even from there I will bring you down declares the LORD

verses.original: אִם־ גַּנָּבִ֤ים בָּאֽוּ־ לְךָ֙ אִם־ שׁ֣וֹדְדֵי לַ֔יְלָה אֵ֣יךְ נִדְמֵ֔יתָה הֲל֥וֹא יִגְנְב֖וּ דַּיָּ֑ם אִם־ בֹּֽצְרִים֙ בָּ֣אוּ לָ֔ךְ הֲל֖וֹא יַשְׁאִ֥ירוּ עֹלֵלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- gan·nā·ḇîm bā·’ū- lə·ḵā ’im- šō·wḏ·ḏê lay·lāh ’êḵ niḏ·mê·ṯāh hă·lō·w yiḡ·nə·ḇū day·yām ’im- bō·ṣə·rîm bā·’ū lāḵ hă·lō·w yaš·’î·rū ‘ō·lê·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: If thieves came to you if robbers by night oh, how you will be ruined would they not steal [only] what they wanted If grape gatherers came to you would they not leave [some] gleanings

verses.original: אֵ֚יךְ עֵשָׂ֔ו נֶחְפְּשׂ֣וּ מַצְפֻּנָֽיו׃ נִבְע֖וּ
verses.transliteration: ’êḵ ‘ê·śāw neḥ·pə·śū maṣ·pu·nāw niḇ·‘ū
verses.literal: But how Esau will be pillaged his hidden treasures sought out

verses.original: כֹּ֚ל אַנְשֵׁ֣י בְרִיתֶ֔ךָ שִׁלְּח֗וּךָ עַֽד־ הַגְּב֣וּל אַנְשֵׁ֣י שְׁלֹמֶ֑ךָ הִשִּׁיא֛וּךָ יָכְל֥וּ לְךָ֖ לַחְמְךָ֗ יָשִׂ֤ימוּ מָזוֹר֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔יךָ אֵ֥ין תְּבוּנָ֖ה בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kōl ’an·šê ḇə·rî·ṯe·ḵā šil·lə·ḥū·ḵā ‘aḏ- hag·gə·ḇūl ’an·šê šə·lō·me·ḵā hiš·šî·’ū·ḵā yā·ḵə·lū lə·ḵā laḥ·mə·ḵā yā·śî·mū mā·zō·wr taḥ·te·ḵā ’ên tə·ḇū·nāh bōw
verses.literal: All the men allied with you will drive you to the border the men at peace with you will deceive and overpower you [Those who eat] your bread will set a trap for you without your awareness of it

verses.original: הַה֖וּא בַּיּ֥וֹם נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה הֲל֛וֹא וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֤י חֲכָמִים֙ מֵֽאֱד֔וֹם וּתְבוּנָ֖ה מֵהַ֥ר עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm nə·’um Yah·weh hă·lō·w wə·ha·’ă·ḇaḏ·tî ḥă·ḵā·mîm mê·’ĕ·ḏō·wm ū·ṯə·ḇū·nāh mê·har ‘ê·śāw
verses.literal: In that day declares the LORD will I not destroy the wise [men] of Edom and the men of understanding in the mountains of Esau

verses.original: גִבּוֹרֶ֖יךָ תֵּימָ֑ן וְחַתּ֥וּ לְמַ֧עַן אִ֛ישׁ מֵהַ֥ר עֵשָׂ֖ו יִכָּֽרֶת־ מִקָּֽטֶל׃
verses.transliteration: ḡib·bō·w·re·ḵā tê·mān wə·ḥat·tū lə·ma·‘an ’îš mê·har ‘ê·śāw yik·kā·reṯ- miq·qā·ṭel
verses.literal: Then your mighty men O Teman will be terrified so that everyone in the mountains of Esau will be cut down in the slaughter

verses.original: מֵחֲמַ֛ס אָחִ֥יךָ יַעֲקֹ֖ב תְּכַסְּךָ֣ בוּשָׁ֑ה וְנִכְרַ֖תָּ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mê·ḥă·mas ’ā·ḥî·ḵā ya·‘ă·qōḇ tə·ḵas·sə·ḵā ḇū·šāh wə·niḵ·ra·tā lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Because of the violence against your brother Jacob you will be covered with shame and cut off forever

verses.original: בְּיוֹם֙ עֲמָֽדְךָ֣ מִנֶּ֔גֶד בְּי֛וֹם זָרִ֖ים שְׁב֥וֹת חֵיל֑וֹ וְנָכְרִ֞ים בָּ֣אוּ שַׁעֲרוֹ יַדּ֣וּ גוֹרָ֔ל גַּם־ וְעַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ אַתָּ֖ה כְּאַחַ֥ד מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yō·wm ‘ă·mā·ḏə·ḵā min·ne·ḡeḏ bə·yō·wm zā·rîm šə·ḇō·wṯ ḥê·lōw wə·nā·ḵə·rîm bā·’ū ša·ʿă·rō yad·dū ḡō·w·rāl gam- wə·‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim ’at·tāh kə·’a·ḥaḏ mê·hem
verses.literal: On the day you stood aloof while strangers carried off his wealth and foreigners entered his gate and cast lots . . . for Jerusalem you were just like one of them

verses.original: וְאַל־ תֵּ֤רֶא בְיוֹם־ אָחִ֙יךָ֙ בְּי֣וֹם נָכְר֔וֹ וְאַל־ תִּשְׂמַ֥ח לִבְנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּי֣וֹם אָבְדָ֑ם וְאַל־ תַּגְדֵּ֥ל פִּ֖יךָ בְּי֥וֹם צָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’al- tê·re ḇə·yō·wm- ’ā·ḥî·ḵā bə·yō·wm nā·ḵə·rōw wə·’al- tiś·maḥ liḇ·nê- yə·hū·ḏāh bə·yō·wm ’ā·ḇə·ḏām wə·’al- taḡ·dêl pî·ḵā bə·yō·wm ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: But you should not gloat in that day your brother’s day of misfortune nor rejoice over the people of Judah in the day of their destruction nor boast proudly . . . in the day of their distress

verses.original: אַל־ תָּב֤וֹא בְשַֽׁעַר־ עַמִּי֙ בְּי֣וֹם אֵידָ֔ם אַל־ תֵּ֧רֶא גַם־ אַתָּ֛ה בְּרָעָת֖וֹ בְּי֣וֹם אֵיד֑וֹ וְאַל־ תִּשְׁלַ֥חְנָה בְחֵיל֖וֹ בְּי֥וֹם אֵידֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tā·ḇō·w ḇə·ša·‘ar- ‘am·mî bə·yō·wm ’ê·ḏām ’al- tê·re ḡam- ’at·tāh bə·rā·‘ā·ṯōw bə·yō·wm ’ê·ḏōw wə·’al- tiš·laḥ·nāh ḇə·ḥê·lōw bə·yō·wm ’ê·ḏōw
verses.literal: You should not enter the gate of My people in the day of their disaster nor gloat over - their affliction in the day of their disaster nor loot their wealth in the day of their disaster

verses.original: וְאַֽל־ תַּעֲמֹד֙ עַל־ הַפֶּ֔רֶק לְהַכְרִ֖ית אֶת־ פְּלִיטָ֑יו וְאַל־ תַּסְגֵּ֥ר שְׂרִידָ֖יו בְּי֥וֹם צָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’al- ta·‘ă·mōḏ ‘al- hap·pe·req lə·haḵ·rîṯ ’eṯ- pə·lî·ṭāw wə·’al- tas·gêr śə·rî·ḏāw bə·yō·wm ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: Nor should you stand at the crossroads to cut off - their fugitives nor deliver up their survivors in the day of their distress

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יוֹם־ יְהוָ֖ה קָר֥וֹב עַל־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ יֵעָ֣שֶׂה לָּ֔ךְ גְּמֻלְךָ֖ יָשׁ֥וּב בְּרֹאשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yō·wm- Yah·weh qā·rō·wḇ ‘al- kāl- hag·gō·w·yim ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯā yê·‘ā·śeh lāḵ gə·mul·ḵā yā·šūḇ bə·rō·še·ḵā
verses.literal: For the Day of the LORD is near for all the nations As you have done it will be done to you your recompense will return upon your own head

verses.original: כִּ֗י כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֤ר שְׁתִיתֶם֙ עַל־ קָדְשִׁ֔י הַ֣ר כָֽל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם יִשְׁתּ֥וּ תָּמִ֑יד וְשָׁת֣וּ וְלָע֔וּ וְהָי֖וּ כְּל֥וֹא הָיֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ka·’ă·šer šə·ṯî·ṯem ‘al- qāḏ·šî har ḵāl hag·gō·w·yim yiš·tū tā·mîḏ wə·šā·ṯū wə·lā·‘ū wə·hā·yū kə·lō·w hā·yū
verses.literal: For as you drank on My holy mountain so all the nations will drink continually They will drink and gulp [it] down they will be as if they had never existed

verses.original: וּבְהַ֥ר צִיּ֛וֹן תִּהְיֶ֥ה פְלֵיטָ֖ה וְהָ֣יָה קֹ֑דֶשׁ בֵּ֣ית יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב אֵ֖ת וְיָֽרְשׁוּ֙ מוֹרָֽשֵׁיהֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·har ṣî·yō·wn tih·yeh p̄ə·lê·ṭāh wə·hā·yāh qō·ḏeš bêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’êṯ wə·yā·rə·šū mō·rå̄·šē·hɛm
verses.literal: But on Mount Zion there will be deliverance and it will be holy and the house of Jacob - will reclaim their possession

verses.original: בֵית־ יַעֲקֹ֨ב וְהָיָה֩ אֵ֜שׁ וּבֵ֧ית יוֹסֵ֣ף לֶהָבָ֗ה וּבֵ֤ית עֵשָׂו֙ לְקַ֔שׁ וְדָלְק֥וּ בָהֶ֖ם וַאֲכָל֑וּם וְלֹֽא־ שָׂרִיד֙ יִֽהְיֶ֤ה לְבֵ֣ית עֵשָׂ֔ו כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḇêṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·hā·yāh ’êš ū·ḇêṯ yō·w·sêp̄ le·hā·ḇāh ū·ḇêṯ ‘ê·śāw lə·qaš wə·ḏā·lə·qū ḇā·hem wa·’ă·ḵā·lūm wə·lō- śā·rîḏ yih·yeh lə·ḇêṯ ‘ê·śāw kî Yah·weh dib·bêr
verses.literal: Then the house of Jacob will be a blazing fire and the house of Joseph a burning flame but the house of Esau will be stubble Jacob will set it ablaze and consume it Therefore no survivor will remain from the house of Esau For the LORD has spoken

verses.original: הַנֶּ֜גֶב אֶת־ וְיָרְשׁ֨וּ הַ֣ר עֵשָׂ֗ו וְהַשְּׁפֵלָה֙ אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְיָרְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־ שְׂדֵ֣ה אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְאֵ֖ת שְׂדֵ֣ה שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וּבִנְיָמִ֖ן אֶת־ הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: han·ne·ḡeḇ ’eṯ- wə·yā·rə·šū har ‘ê·śāw wə·haš·šə·p̄ê·lāh ’eṯ- pə·liš·tîm wə·yā·rə·šū ’eṯ- śə·ḏêh ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·’êṯ śə·ḏêh šō·mə·rō·wn ū·ḇin·yā·min ’eṯ- hag·gil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: Those from the Negev - will possess the mountains of Esau those from the foothills - [will possess the land] of the Philistines They will occupy - the fields of Ephraim - - and Samaria and Benjamin [will possess] - Gilead

verses.original: וְגָלֻ֣ת הַ֠זֶּה הַֽחֵל־ לִבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֲשֶֽׁר־ כְּנַעֲנִים֙ עַד־ צָ֣רְפַ֔ת וְגָלֻ֥ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּסְפָרַ֑ד יִֽרְשׁ֕וּ אֵ֖ת עָרֵ֥י הַנֶּֽגֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡā·luṯ haz·zeh ha·ḥêl- liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer- kə·na·‘ă·nîm ‘aḏ- ṣā·rə·p̄aṯ wə·ḡā·luṯ yə·rū·šā·lim ’ă·šer bis·p̄ā·raḏ yir·šū ’êṯ ‘ā·rê han·ne·ḡeḇ
verses.literal: And the exiles of this host vvv of the Israelites [will possess the land] of the Canaanites as far as Zarephath and the exiles from Jerusalem who are in Sepharad will possess - the cities of the Negev

verses.original: מֽוֹשִׁעִים֙ וְעָל֤וּ בְּהַ֣ר צִיּ֔וֹן לִשְׁפֹּ֖ט אֶת־ הַ֣ר עֵשָׂ֑ו הַמְּלוּכָֽה׃ וְהָיְתָ֥ה לַֽיהוָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: mō·wō·ši·‘îm wə·‘ā·lū bə·har ṣî·yō·wn liš·pōṭ ’eṯ- har ‘ê·śāw ham·mə·lū·ḵāh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: The deliverers will ascend Mount Zion to rule over - the mountains of Esau And the kingdom will belong to the LORD
